run_predict_city_names: run the ATIS model to predict city names from a text string and return token ranges
run_tokenize_text: run the tokenize function to split text into lowercase tokens with character offset ranges
review_predict_function: review the predict function that runs the Caffe2 ATIS model and extracts city name token ranges
review_tokenize_function: review the tokenize function that splits text by whitespace and returns tokens with ranges
summarize_predict_net: summarize the loaded Caffe2 ATIS joint prediction network used for city name entity recognition
